extracted text: H-ITQ-13 is typically synthesized by the fluoride route in highly concentrated synthesis mixtures using hexamethonium hydroxide (HM(OH)2) as a structure directing agent (SDA). The synthesis mixture of ITQ-13(N) was prepared by dissolving GeO2 in HM(OH)2 aqueous solution, then adding Al-isopropoxide dissolved in isopropanol, followed by dropwise addition of TEOS. The final molar composition was 91 SiO2:1 Al2O3:9 GeO2:56 HF:25 HM(OH)2:500 H2O. Small amounts of pure Si-ITQ-13 seed crystals were added and the mixture was kept in a tumbling oven at 37 rpm for 14 days at 160°C. For H-ITQ-13(P), the same procedure was followed with nearly identical synthesis composition but 10.7% less fluoride (50HF instead of 56HF). For making Si-ITQ-13 seeds, the synthesis mixture had a final molar composition of 100 SiO2:50 HF:25 HM(OH)2:500 H2O.
property mapping: SiO2 -> Si, Al2O3 -> Al, GeO2 -> Ge, HF -> HF, HM(OH)2 -> osda_names and osda_ratios, H2O -> H2O, 160°C -> crystallization_temperature, 14 days -> crystallization_time, ITQ-13 -> product_names
formula abbreviations: HM(OH)2 = hexamethonium hydroxide. Al2O3 represents 2 Al atoms per formula unit. The tumbling oven was operated at 37 rpm.
